entries.title: Hosea 10:1
segments: Israel is a luxuriant vine, that putteth forth his fruit: according to the abundance of his fruit he hath multiplied his altars; according to the goodness of their land they have made goodly pillars.

entries.title: Hosea 10:2
segments: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found guilty: he will smite their altars, he will destroy their pillars.

entries.title: Hosea 10:3
segments: Surely now shall they say, We have no king; for we fear not Jehovah; and the king, what can he do for us?

entries.title: Hosea 10:4
segments: They speak [vain] words, swearing falsely in making covenants: therefore judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.

entries.title: Hosea 10:5
segments: The inhabitants of Samaria shall be in terror for the calves of Beth-aven; for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced over it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.

entries.title: Hosea 10:6
segments: It also shall be carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

entries.title: Hosea 10:7
segments: [As for] Samaria, her king is cut off, as foam upon the water.

entries.title: Hosea 10:8
segments: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

entries.title: Hosea 10:9
segments: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood; the battle against the children of iniquity doth not overtake them in Gibeah.

entries.title: Hosea 10:10
segments: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the peoples shall be gathered against them, when they are bound to their two transgressions.

entries.title: Hosea 10:11
segments: And Ephraim is a heifer that is taught, that loveth to tread out [the grain]; but I have passed over upon her fair neck: I will set a rider on Ephraim; Judah shall plow, Jacob shall break his clods.

entries.title: Hosea 10:12
segments: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness; break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Jehovah, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

entries.title: Hosea 10:13
segments: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies; for thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.

entries.title: Hosea 10:14
segments: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces with her children.

entries.title: Hosea 10:15
segments: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: at daybreak shall the king of Israel be utterly cut off.
